subject: General Knowledge
title: Class 10 General Knowledge Olympiad — Paper 4
instructions: The time allowed for this paper is 60 minutes.
This paper contains 50 objective-type (multiple-choice) questions carrying a total of 60 marks.
There is no negative marking for wrong answers.
Each question has four options; choose the one correct answer.
Section 1 and other regular sections carry 1 mark per question; the Achievers Section carries 3 marks per question.
Use of calculators is not permitted unless specified.

questions.question: A team project is falling behind schedule because members are not communicating. What is the best solution?

questions.question: Which quality is most important when accepting constructive criticism?

options: Trying to understand how someone else feels in a situation

questions.question: If a classmate is being bullied, what is the most responsible action to take?
options: Support the classmate and report it to a trusted teacher or adult

questions.question: What is the best way to handle a disagreement with a friend?
options: Involve other friends to take sides

Talk calmly and listen to their perspective

questions.question: What is an effective way to manage stress before a big test?
options: Practicing deep breathing and staying organized with preparation

questions.question: What is the healthiest way to cope with failure in an exam?

questions.question: Which behaviour best shows responsible digital citizenship?

questions.question: A region invests heavily in renewable energy sources like solar and wind over the next decade. What is a likely long-term outcome for that region?
options: Immediate elimination of all energy costs
Reduced dependence on fossil fuels and lower long-term carbon emissions

questions.question: During a natural disaster like a flood, why is it important for communities to have an early warning system?
options: It allows people time to evacuate and take precautions, reducing loss of life and property

questions.question: If a country's currency value drops sharply against other currencies, what is a likely effect on its imports and exports?
options: Both imports and exports become cheaper
Imports become more expensive while exports become cheaper for foreign buyers
There is no effect on trade
Both imports and exports become more expensive

questions.question: A country's literacy rate has been steadily rising over the past decade due to increased investment in schools. What long-term impact would this most likely have on the nation's economy?
options: No impact on the economy at all
A decrease in the availability of jobs
A more skilled workforce, potentially boosting economic growth and innovation

questions.question: Two neighbouring countries share a river as a water source, and one builds a large dam upstream. What is a likely diplomatic concern this could raise?
options: Only environmental groups would be concerned, not governments
The upstream country loses all rights to the river
The downstream country may face reduced water flow, leading to disputes over water sharing
There would be no effect since rivers regenerate water instantly
